sources.snippet: The next logical step was to put a filesystem inside the weights. This is experimental and still in progress: the model is up as divagr1925/Qwen3.5-4B-Qwenputer-Filesystem (also on ModelScope), and its code lives on the rv-store branch for now. It's the same RISC-V model with five more tools next to calc: put, append, get, list and delete.
